hero.title: You've been invited
hero.subtitle: Join a dealership team on Carsens.

noToken.title: No invitation link
noToken.body: This page needs the link from your invitation email. Open that email again and tap the button inside it.

dead.title: This invitation can't be used
dead.body: It may have expired, been withdrawn, or already been accepted. Ask the dealership to send you a new invitation.

signIn.title: Sign in to accept
signIn.body: There's already a Carsens account for {{email}}. Sign in and we'll bring you straight back here.

create.title: Create your account
create.body: Pick a name and password for {{email}}. This link is proof of your email address, so there's nothing else to confirm.

accept.title: Accept your invitation
accept.body: {{dealerName}} is waiting for you to join.

wrongAccount.title: That's a different account
wrongAccount.body: This invitation was sent to {{invited}}, but you're signed in as {{current}}. Only the invited address can accept it.

joined.title: You're in
joined.body: Welcome to {{dealerName}} — taking you to the dealer portal.

signInFallback.title: Account created
signInFallback.body: Your account for {{email}} is ready and you've joined the team, but we couldn't sign you in automatically. Sign in with the password you just chose.

email.label: Email address
email.hint: The invitation is tied to this address and can't be moved to another.

password.label: Password
password.hint: At least 8 characters, with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a digit.

actions.signOutAndSwitch: Sign out and sign in as {{invited}}

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
